6.text: Global EV sales grew 20% to over 20 million in 2025, with fast-charging and wind infrastructure expanding. Rivian, BYD, and Lucid drew investor attention; Tesla appears only as a comparison benchmark, not the focus.

8.text: Tesla unveiled a redesigned Roadster in Texas, demonstrating short-burst flight using SpaceX-developed thrusters, with production planned for 2028 in three configurations. The stock rose nearly 5% premarket before paring gains.

16.text: Tesla is barely mentioned; the articles mainly report a volatile tech selloff, with the Nasdaq down 4% for the week, followed by a pre-earnings rebound in futures as traders await Big Tech results.

12.text: Musk is pursuing a $15B chip factory for Tesla and SpaceX despite admitting he doesn't know how to make chips, with Tesla investors possibly funding much of it; TSMC is open to collaborating but insists on controlling its plants. Separately, Musk donated $158M to GOP Senate groups and $276M total to Republican causes, and he argues AI and robots are the only way to solve America's $40T debt.

4.text: Tesla's Austin robotaxi fleet grew from under 40 to over 300 Cybercabs in a month, with Dallas next, while NHTSA opened a second probe into alleged school-zone speeding. Musk said Optimus and Cybercab will be most of Tesla's value, and investors await Q3 details on sales and regulation.

7.text: Tesla reports Q3 earnings October 21 with consensus of $0.44 EPS and $27.8B revenue, after deliveries fell 2.1% year-over-year to 486,532 vehicles. Analysts flag weak automotive margins, negative free cash flow, and high valuation despite record deliveries and a $43 billion cash pile.

5.text: SpaceX is expected to report its first adjusted profit, while analysts and investors debate its high valuation and speculate that a Tesla merger could be announced before Tesla’s annual meeting. SpaceX also faces scrutiny over a White House-ordered slowdown of Starshield service in Ukraine.

17.text: Bybit added over 1,000 tokenized US stocks, Securitize shares rose on its tokenized trading launch, and analysts raised targets on Securitize, Coinbase and Robinhood while BofA cut eToro. With US markets closed, Musk's flying Roadster reveal drove Hyperliquid's tokenized TSLA perpetual volume up about 1,580%.

15.text: Tesla unveiled a next-generation Roadster featuring SpaceX rocket technology, prompting analyst skepticism and SpaceX merger rumors. Other segments covered AI stock sell-offs, TSMC earnings, Meta-Apple AI talks, and housing.
